Patch Set 19:

(1 comment)
Besides a minor comment on file naming, it looks good to me

Similar to naming of `http/routing/websocketrule.cpp`, would this be better named as `http/websocket.cpp`?

Or, the other way around like `http/routing/websocketrule_impl.cpp`?

> Similar to naming of `http/routing/websocketrule.cpp`, would this be better named as `http/websocket.cpp`?
> 
> Or, the other way around like `http/routing/websocketrule_impl.cpp`?

I'm not following how that would be correct.
1. This is a header, not a compile unit, so .cpp isn't correct
2. We need some way to differentiate ConnectionImpl from Connection.  If we named this websocket.cpp, that could conflict if we ever moved Connection and methods to a compile unit.

Is there another name you could suggest that captures that this is a "ConnectionImpl". My thought process here was

Connection -> lives in websocket.hpp
ConnectionImpl -> can live in websocket_impl.hpp

Yes, you're right. I was confused on the file name.
`weksocket_impl.hpp` would be good as is.
Why not also move this? Oh well.
